value.rationale: K5 is the first nontrivial metric-vs-cut relaxation. The theorem quantifies the sharp worst-case ℓp approximation error for every p and its dual maximum-cut LP objective gap, determining complete primal and finite-p dual equality configurations. This is a natural global invariant and useful LP-normalization benchmark, not a restatement of the known 32-vertex enumeration.
